sec.title: August 25 Exhaustive Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 98)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the comprehensive provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial multi-part narrative arcs, and story synopses for historical broadcasts transmitting on **August 25** across American network, Sammy Kaye's swinging big band live from Pennsylvania's Hershey Theatre for Plymouth, two compelling productions on *CBS Romance* directed by William N. Robson and Antony Ellis, Jimmy Scribner's extraordinary 22-character solo voice mastery on *The Johnson Family*, and classic Hummert daytime serial drama on *Betty and Bob* (1946–1956):
